l8hu-exploitative: HU Exploitation: Not Abandoning GTO, Calibrating It

HU exploitative play profits from the opponent's deviations from equilibrium. But HU pros don't "abandon" GTO; they "calibrate" it: using equilibrium frequencies as the baseline and making minimum necessary deviations against the opponent's clear deviations. HU is the format where reading people is most valuable — facing one opponent, you can quickly identify his leaks and harvest with targeted strategies.

The right posture of exploitation: aim the direction at the opponent's leak (Maximally Exploitative), keep the magnitude minimal (Minimally Exploitative). Every deviation opens your own leaks, so keep the magnitude controlled and return to baseline when the opponent adjusts.
Frequency Reading: From Statistics to Exploitation

Frequency reading is the foundation of HU exploitation: identify the opponent's four-dimensional tendencies (open rate, fold rate vs C-Bets, 3-bet rate, showdown tendency), then harvest with targeted strategies. Folds too much → raise C-Bet/steal frequency; calls too loose (station) → value-bet thin value and cut pure bluffs; 3-bets too often → narrow the open and add 4Bet; C-Bets too often → raise x/r. Identification relies on 50-100 hand statistics; single-hand impressions don't count.

Example: You observe a HU opponent who folds to C-Bets at 62% (equilibrium ~45%). That's a clear over-folding leak. Exploit: raise your flop C-Bet frequency and bluff density overall, even adding weak hands that originally checked to the betting range. But cap it at "I still don't lose if he tightens to 50%" — keeping correction room. That's a "directed, disciplined deviation".

Example 2 (range polarization): Against a station who calls too loose, polarize your betting range — bet value with the nuts, semi-bluff with strong draws, check middle hands. Because the station calls with weak hands, your wide value range gets overpaid. Meanwhile cut pure bluffs (he doesn't fold) and convert bluffs to semi-bluffs or checks.

Example 3 (dynamic adjustment): After you raise steal frequency, the opponent starts 3-betting frequently — he's discovered your deviation. Now you must return to the GTO baseline (narrow the steal range, reduce pure bluffs), or your newly opened leaks get harvested in reverse. Exploitation is a dynamic game: deviate → get detected → return to baseline, looping.

Counterintuitive point: the biggest risk of exploitation isn't "exploiting too little" but "over-exploiting and becoming the leak yourself". HU pros always keep one hand on the GTO baseline wheel while harvesting — the moment the opponent adjusts, they snap back.

Exploitation execution in five steps: (1) HUD-collect enough samples to confirm the leak; (2) lock the node in a solver for the optimal response; (3) compare to baseline and mark the pushed-up frequencies and sizes; (4) execute live; (5) re-check the sample every 500 hands. A "lock" without data support is exploitation on paper.

l8hu-exploitative-q1.question: The correct basis of HU exploitation is:
options: Using GTO as the baseline and making minimum necessary deviations against clear opponent deviations
l8hu-exploitative-q1.explanation: Exploitation is "calibrating GTO" rather than abandoning it: using equilibrium frequencies as the baseline and making directed, capped deviations against opponent deviations.

l8hu-exploitative-q2.question: Against an over-folding opponent, HU exploitation is:
options: Raise C-Bet/steal frequency and bluff density
l8hu-exploitative-q2.explanation: An over-folding opponent makes steal and C-Bet fold rates automatic profit — raise C-Bet/steal frequency and bluff density.

l8hu-exploitative-q3.question: Against a station who calls too loose, the correct exploitation is:
options: Polarize the betting range, value-bet thin value, cut pure bluffs
l8hu-exploitative-q3.explanation: A station calls with weak hands so thin value bets get overpaid; pure bluffs are useless (he doesn't fold) — convert to semi-bluffs or checks.

l8hu-exploitative-q4.question: After you raise steals, the opponent starts 3-betting frequently. The correct move is:
options: Return to the GTO baseline and narrow the range
l8hu-exploitative-q4.explanation: The opponent detected your deviation and your newly opened leaks will be harvested in reverse — you must return to baseline. Exploitation is a "deviate → get detected → return" dynamic game.

l8hu-exploitative-q5.explanation: Frequency reading relies on 50-100 hand statistics (open rate/fold rate/3-bet rate/showdown tendency); single-hand impressions are noise.
